facts.fact: The KNMI peer-reviewed Country Hydromet Diagnostic says INMG receives EUMETSAT near-real-time Meteosat data at Ilha do Sal through MESSIR SAT and PUMA systems and uses the products in its forecasts.
facts.system: MESSIR SAT and PUMA reception systems (EUMETSAT Meteosat MSG)

facts.fact: The Country Hydromet Diagnostic says INMG uses EUMETSAT Meteosat 3-km, 15-minute observations for short-term early warning, and that it runs a 24/7 weather alert service with 12 to 48 hour lead times.
facts.system: MESSIR SAT and PUMA reception systems (EUMETSAT Meteosat MSG)

systems.platform: EUMETSAT Meteosat MSG reception at Ilha do Sal
